note: Six workflows can fire on a schedule today: daily_signal_research (daily), monday_publish (Mon), wednesday_golden (Wed), scheduled_publish (Fri), research_generate_and_publish (Fri+Sun), visibility_publish (Tue+Thu). Only monday_publish, wednesday_golden and research_generate_and_publish share the `never-blank-publish` concurrency group.

entries.purpose: Daily research pipeline: discovery, scoring, enrichment, angles, image preparation, archive, sheet sync, and (behind a secret) Stage 11 publication. Commits the resulting signal state back to main.
entries.consumer: GitHub Actions cron `0 8 * * *` (:5) and workflow_dispatch (:6). Entry script `scripts/research/run_daily_research.py` (:85).
entries.evidence: daily_signal_research.yml:5, :85, :106 (`git add data/research/ data/memory/ reports/research_*.json reports/content_packages/*.json`). Recent executions are visible as commits 'research: daily signal update 2026-09-16' (265d658) and its predecessors.
entries.action_required: No concurrency group (F-06); installs an ad-hoc package list rather than requirements.txt (F-11).

entries.purpose: Monday stream: due check, role-bounded eligible-signal selection, then the canonical entrypoint with `--editorial-role never-blank-monday-documented-case`. Publishes Wix + LinkedIn and commits the consumed signal id.
entries.consumer: cron `17 8 * * 1` and `17 9 * * 1` (:29-30, the #232 America/New_York 04:17 contract), workflow_dispatch (:32). Scripts: scripts/streams/due_check.py (:84), scripts/streams/select_eligible_signal.py (:159), scripts/generate_and_publish.py (:271).
entries.action_required: None from this audit. Monday is blocked on supply (#237), which is out of scope here.

entries.purpose: Wednesday Golden stream: due check, then the canonical entrypoint with `--editorial-role never-blank-wednesday-golden`, routed to the restored July pipeline.
entries.evidence: wednesday_golden.yml:6-13, :57, :211, :231-232; concurrency `never-blank-publish` (:32-34). The 2026-09-16 firing published run f9c2f40f85d82da3 (commit 14e4886).
entries.action_required: None here. Wednesday's architecture is owner-paused while the schedule keeps running (#234 comment 2026-09-16); the configured Golden contract does not reach generation — see 02_config.json for config/never_blank/wednesday_golden.yaml.

entries.purpose: Friday stream. Checks the config/schedule.yaml window, then runs scripts/scheduled_publish.py, which shells out to the legacy generator and the legacy six-channel publisher.
entries.evidence: scheduled_publish.yml:13-26, :86-91; scripts/scheduled_publish.py:226-240 subprocesses `generate.py --qc`, `generate_image.py --upload`, `publish.py --live --channels ...` for wix, linkedin, facebook, instagram, threads and telegram.
entries.action_required: HIGH. This is a live cron in front of a path that release_scope does not cover and that the owner declared paused (#234, 2026-09-15). It has no concurrency group and shares Friday with research_generate_and_publish.yml. See findings F-01 and F-05.

entries.purpose: Research Full LLM cycle on Friday and Sunday: auto-selects a signal from signals_active.jsonl and runs the canonical entrypoint with no editorial role.
entries.evidence: research_generate_and_publish.yml:28-34, :57-85 (auto-select), :170; concurrency `never-blank-publish` (:37-39). Because it passes no `--editorial-role`, no Never Blank role rules and no role-bounded decision policy apply to its output (scripts/generate_and_publish.py:1286 requires `_role.decision_policy == 'role_bounded_r1'`).
entries.action_required: HIGH. Publication ownership of this Fri/Sun path is the open question the issue asks about; see findings F-05. Its 'Check publish secrets' step is skipped on scheduled runs because `if: inputs.dry_run == 'false'` (:100) and `inputs` is empty on a cron.

entries.purpose: Visibility Intelligence stream on Tuesday and Thursday: drains data/strategy/visibility_queue.jsonl through the VI pipeline and publishes inside the R1 scope.
entries.action_required: Its `git add reports/content_packages/` (:102) is unbounded and will commit whatever a run left in that directory — the mechanism behind F-02. It also has no concurrency group (F-06).

entries.purpose: The repository's only full-suite gate: runs all of pytest on every PR to main and compares the failed node-id set against tests/accepted_full_suite_failures.txt.
entries.consumer: pull_request to main (:14) and workflow_dispatch (:16); scripts/ci/check_test_baseline.py (:54).
entries.action_required: This gate is where the guardrail of F-10 belongs.

entries.purpose: Path-filtered strategy/analytics gate: py_compile of 17 named modules plus the tests/strategy and tests/analytics suites.
entries.consumer: push to main and pull_request on the listed paths (:4-29), workflow_dispatch (:30).
entries.action_required: Its py_compile list names four scripts (build_monthly_plan, run_weekly_review, run_monthly_review, approve_strategy_recommendation) that no workflow executes — compilation is not a consumer. See 04_scripts.json.

entries.purpose: Path-filtered guard on the research publishing path: py_compile of four modules plus tests/test_output_guard.py.
entries.consumer: push to main on scripts/research/**, src/editorial/**, src/content/output_guard.py, tests/test_output_guard.py (:4-11); workflow_dispatch (:12).

entries.purpose: Manual legacy generate-then-publish: scripts/generate.py --qc, scripts/generate_image.py --upload, scripts/publish.py.
entries.evidence: generate_and_publish.yml:3-4, :49, :106-108. Not the canonical entrypoint: the canonical one is scripts/generate_and_publish.py, a different file with a confusingly similar name.
entries.canonical: legacy; superseded by monday_publish.yml / wednesday_golden.yml for real publication
entries.action_required: Name collision with scripts/generate_and_publish.py is a live foot-gun (F-09). Retained for manual recovery.

entries.purpose: Manual legacy content generation only (no publish).
Manual image-pipeline run, optionally against a synthetic fixture.
Manual publish of an existing draft through the legacy six-channel publisher.
entries.evidence: publish.yml:3-4, :79-81. scripts/publish.py:50-58 maps all six channels and does not import src/publishing/release_scope.py.
entries.action_required: Manual use of a non-scope-gated publisher is accepted (tests/test_r1_publish_scope.py:217 'manual publishers may still reach every channel'); the defect is that scheduled_publish.yml reaches the same script on a cron (F-01).

entries.purpose: Manual live publication smoke test across the channel matrix; writes reports/live_publish_test.{json,md}.
Manual publish-then-analytics smoke test for one signal.

entries.action_required: Low: document or generate its input fixture.

Manual analytics collection across Wix and LinkedIn.

entries.purpose: One-off, manual-only recovery that publishes the saved Facebook/Instagram/Threads payloads of Wednesday run 35102307491 and nothing else.
entries.evidence: recovery_wednesday_meta_247.yml:6-20 states the containment (no schedule, dry_run default, typed run-id confirmation, read-only token, Meta-family secrets only, single-shot guard). Merged as 4a121b2.
entries.action_required: Its own header (:9) and the script docstring (publish_saved_wednesday_meta.py:39) both ask for removal after the recovery. It is still dispatchable and is the one workflow that can publish to non-R1 channels by design. Track the cleanup PR (F-08).
